column1: # Campaign 22 pd-client source evidence for pd-fallible-worker-lifecycle-runtime.

column5: Campaign 22 separates one unique PD worker owner from cloneable request handles and makes explicit close and join fallible. The complete PD client option, router, retry, TLS, forwarding, service-mode, and observability surface remains open.

The retained TSO stream remains worker-owned and is cancelled before close and join through the unique lifecycle owner. Full batching, locality, forwarding, adaptive latency, concurrent queueing, and background failure detection remain open.

Cloneable PD request handles share membership state without acquiring worker close or join authority, and explicit owner shutdown closes retained work. Background health loops, callbacks, TLS, forwarding, and dynamic service modes remain open.
